prose: A Techmeme excerpt attributes a European Commission cyberattack report to Politico and an account of AI-assisted intrusion tools to CERT-EU. The supplied link resolves only to the publication homepage, which was inaccessible. The affected systems, duration and tool attribution could not be independently checked; the excerpt does not establish how much AI contributed to the attack.
highlights: Evidence is a short indexed excerpt
Supplied URL is not an article-specific link
Tool attribution was not independently checked
AI contribution cannot be quantified from the excerpt
